instructions: This cookie dough is full of semi sweet morsels, for a cookie that delivers the rich, creamy semi-sweet chocolate taste you love from Nestle Toll House.
Davids Cookies Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, 1.33 Ounce -- 252 per case.

Delicious Flavors - Whether you want classic chocolate chip cookies, a creamy oreos cookie dough, or a pop of cherry, we got you covered! Enjoy all of our delicious unbaked cookie dough flavors: Rocket Chip, Galactic Fusion, and Super Cluster.
Chocolate chip cookie dough chunks are made with non gmo sourced ingredients, fairtrade certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla, and cage free eggs. feel good about every doughy bite.
Ready To Bake Sugar Cookies are super simple — just place and bake for cookies in minutes.
NO MIXING, NO MESS: Refrigerated cookie dough is easy to use — just place and bake
And with Ready To Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, you can make any day special in minutes.
Snickerdoodle Cookie Dough Cups are that ready-to-eat treat that you just eat (no baking required).
GET YOUR HOMEMADE COOKIE WITHOUT ALL THE MESS.
